decisions.reason: This space camera has had its own page for two years and fits the firm's core star-tracker and optical business, so performance appears to meet aspiration and space product lifecycles are long.
The modular camera shares flight heritage with the HERA launch success, which exceeds aspiration and gives no trigger for problemistic search.
The space situational awareness market is growing with defence interest, and a large firm's slack allows it to carry this product while results are still uncertain.
The LiDAR is only mentioned and has no reported result, but miniaturized rendezvous LiDAR is strategic and qualification investments are sunk, so slack supports keeping it.
This newly launched radiation-hard camera has its own page and fits demand from constellations and deep-space missions, so it is too early to judge it short of aspiration.
The asteroid camera is tied to the successful HERA mission and carries reputational value, though its mere mention suggests a niche, mission-specific product.
